description: This file implements command-line functionality for handling Git bundle files, including creating, verifying, listing heads, and unbundling bundles. It defines command usage help strings, parses command-line options, opens bundle files, and coordinates various bundle operations.

methods.name: int cmd_bundle_verify(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Handles the 'git bundle verify' subcommand, verifying the integrity of a bundle file.

methods.name: int cmd_bundle_list_heads(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)

methods.name: int cmd_bundle_unbundle(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Handles the 'git bundle unbundle' subcommand, extracting objects from the bundle into the repository.

methods.description: Main entry point for the 'bundle' command, dispatching to subcommands based on user input.
